去掉 以下内容里的重复内容(不用翻译):

PR 178 turned on Fabric/TurboModules at runtime while Android still uses the legacy architecture, so testers and other iOS builders would keep shipping a broken Dev app.
ios/Circle/Info.plist - Remove RCTNewArchEnabled=true added in PR 178. - Leaving that key set makes RN 0.81 start in the new architecture even though android/gradle.properties has newArchEnabled=false and JS still expects the legacy bridge.
package.json - Pin react-native-reanimated back to 3.16.3 (undo 3.19.5). - 3.19.5 was bumped for Xcode 26 compile only and does not match the restored patch or the pre-PR iOS native stack other developers already use.
patches/react-native-reanimated+3.16.3.patch - Restore the patch PR 178 deleted. - It keeps 3.16.3 compatible with RN 0.81 Android (16KB page size linker flags, Systrace TRACE_TAG_REACT, and RN 0.81 drawable/border APIs).
fix(ios): keep RN 0.81 on Legacy Architecture and pin the Mac install toolchain
RN 0.81 treats a missing RCTNewArchEnabled Info.plist key as enabled. Disable New Architecture at runtime in AppDelegate and set RCTNewArchEnabled=false so iOS matches Android newArchEnabled=false.
Fail pod install unless Node.js is >= 20.19.4 and react-native-reanimated, react-native-date-picker, and react-native-screens match package.json. Pin Node with .nvmrc 20.20.2, engines, and .npmrc engine-strict plus legacy-peer-deps. Pin date-picker 5.0.7 and screens 4.19.0.

合并后如下，重复信息已去掉，原文未翻译：

TestFlight 1.0.3 (3) and (4) abort about two seconds after launch on iPad (SIGABRT on `com.meta.react.turbomodulemanager.queue` / `ObjCTurboModule::performVoidMethodInvocation`). PR 178 turned on Fabric/TurboModules at runtime while Android still uses the legacy architecture, so testers and other iOS builders would keep shipping a broken Dev app.

`fix(ios): keep RN 0.81 on Legacy Architecture and pin the Mac install toolchain`

- RN 0.81 treats a missing `RCTNewArchEnabled` Info.plist key as enabled. Disable New Architecture at runtime in `AppDelegate` and set `RCTNewArchEnabled=false` (undo the `true` added in PR 178) so iOS matches `android/gradle.properties` `newArchEnabled=false` and the JS that still expects the legacy bridge.
- Pin `react-native-reanimated` back to 3.16.3 (undo 3.19.5). 3.19.5 was bumped for Xcode 26 compile only and does not match the restored patch or the pre-PR iOS native stack other developers already use.
- Restore `patches/react-native-reanimated+3.16.3.patch` (deleted in PR 178) and extend it to use C++ `<atomic>` instead of `stdatomic.h` so Legacy Architecture compiles on current Xcode. The patch also keeps 3.16.3 compatible with RN 0.81 Android (16KB page size linker flags, Systrace `TRACE_TAG_REACT`, and RN 0.81 drawable/border APIs).
- Fail `pod install` unless Node.js is `>= 20.19.4` and `react-native-reanimated`, `react-native-date-picker`, and `react-native-screens` match `package.json`. Pin Node with `.nvmrc` 20.20.2, `engines`, and `.npmrc` `engine-strict` plus `legacy-peer-deps`. Pin date-picker 5.0.7 and screens 4.19.0.
